> I am not sure about this really, but I guess if we do it for the interface, we should do it for abstract classes as well.

I am not sure either. The reason why I care for this is that even when I annotated class that extends abstract parent with `@Singleton` I still got issue in _one_ of many cases. I thought if you fix this issue, I won't have to continue with debugging why it happens in exactly one situation. It might be something specific to `QuarkusUnitTest` or I made some mistake. Anyway it's hard to find a reason for me. If this is not getting fixed, I'll try to create a reproducer.
No worries, I'll look into it when I have some time.

issue.title: Allow use of abstract classes in Quarkus REST in the same way as interfaces
Quarkus REST in NATIVE - abstract resources with @Path requires impl. to be CDI beans while RESTEasy does not
issue.body:
### Describe the bug

 Quarkus REST in NATIVE - abstract resources with `@Path` requires impl. to be CDI beans while RESTEasy does not

This is basically https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/41567 for NATIVE mode.

https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/41606 fixed the issue for JVM mode, but NATIVE is still broken, stacktrace appears after first request.

### Expected behavior

The same behavior as in JVM mode.

### Actual behavior

`2024-09-02 23:43:52,344 ERROR [io.qua.ver.htt.run.QuarkusErrorHandler] (executor-thread-1) HTTP Request to /hello failed, error id: 2061ff63-7e62-4ace-8e5b-1103e212d2f9-1: java.lang.IllegalArgumentException: Unable to create class 'org.acme.GreetingResource'. To fix the problem, make sure this class is a CDI bean.` is thrown

### How to Reproduce?

0. `sdk use java 21.0.2-graalce` ## or equivalent for Mandrel
1. `git clone git@github.com:michalvavrik/abstract-quarkus-rest-repro.git`
2. `cd abstract-quarkus-rest-repro`
3. `mvn clean verify -Dnative -Dquarkus.platform.group-id=io.quarkus -Dquarkus.platform.version=999-SNAPSHOT`

After switching `<artifactId>quarkus-rest</artifactId>` to `<artifactId>quarkus-resteasy</artifactId>` the app works well.
